summary.answer: Mutates and returns the supplied array. Starting at its length while >=2, chooses math.random(currentLength), swaps that entry with the last current entry and decrements the bound. RNG implementation and seed are external. Reads surveyId from current-player AAR stats. A zero match-ID returns false,false. Otherwise creates/updates lobbyRoot.lastMatchID before duplicate checking. Repeated IDs return false,false. surveyId 0 returns a random survey-chance result,false for quitters, else false,true; a nonzero surveyId returns true,false. Missing stat structure returns false,true. The first argument is unused in this span.
